India Launches First Hydrogen Train, A New Era for Sustainable Transportation

The Indian government has launched its first hydrogen train in the state of Haryana, marking a significant milestone in the country's transition to sustainable transportation. The train is part of the 'Namaste Green' initiative, aimed at reducing carbon emissions and promoting eco-friendly practices. The launch comes ahead of the country's commitment to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 33-35% by 2030.
